name: How do plumbers diagnose recurring drain clogs?

mainEntity.name: How do plumbers diagnose recurring drain clogs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plumbers diagnose recurring clogs using various methods. A common approach is a video pipe inspection, where a small camera is inserted into the drain line to visually identify blockages, pipe damage, or root intrusion. They may also use hydro-jetting to clear stubborn blockages and assess flow. These tools provide a clear understanding of the problem's exact location and nature, allowing for targeted repairs.
